definitionZh: 溢出内置的 CSS 属性设定了当内容溢出一个框的内置起始和结尾边缘时显示的内容 。 这可能是什么,一个卷轴条,或溢出的内容。
sourceDefinition: The overflow-inline CSS property sets what shows when content overflows the inline start and end edges of a box. This may be nothing, a scroll bar, or the overflow content.

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: The overflow-inline CSS property sets what shows when content overflows the inline start and end edges of a box. This may be nothing, a scroll bar, or the overflow content.
